name: sneak
description: Sneaking and knocking people out. `sneak` drops you into the sneaking posture and everyone in the room rolls to notice you — while unnoticed your arrival is never announced and you are absent from that viewer's `look`, but the clock keeps giving the room another look at you. `knockout` requires sneaking and puts an unaware target out cold; failure makes an NPC bolt and shout, and an enemy turn on you, and a success in front of witnesses does both. Combat itself is untouched and remains to the death.
